questions.stem: According to the passage, under what condition can ferrihydrite form?
options: In dry, cold environments similar to modern Mars
In water-rich environments
Only in laboratory settings using synthetic material
In areas with no oxygen present
questions.evidence: The mineral appears reddish in color and can form in water-rich environments.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에 페리하이드라이트가 물이 풍부한 환경에서 형성될 수 있다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.stem: All of the following are mentioned as sources of data used in the study EXCEPT:
options: The Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
The European Space Agency's Mars Express and Trace Gas orbiters
Rovers operating on Mars
Samples already returned to Earth by the Perseverance rover
questions.evidence: He added, “When we get those back, we will be able to check whether our theory about ferrihydrite is correct."
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에 따르면 퍼서비어런스 로버가 채취한 샘플은 아직 지구로 돌아오지 않았으므로 이번 연구의 데이터 출처가 아닙니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the significance of finding widespread ferrihydrite on Mars?
options: It proves that Mars currently has flowing liquid water
It suggests Mars may once have had conditions suitable for some form of life
It confirms that hematite is not present anywhere on Mars
It shows that Mars has never had oxygen in its atmosphere
questions.evidence: Valantinas noted the discovery of widespread ferrihydrite suggests Mars once held liquid water that would have made it possible for the planet to support some form of life.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에서 광범위한 페리하이드라이트 발견이 과거 화성이 생명체를 지탱할 수 있었을 가능성을 시사한다고 언급되어 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention that "past studies had suggested a mineral called hematite might be the cause"?
options: To prove that hematite is the correct explanation for Mars's color
To provide background on previous explanations before presenting the new finding
To criticize the methods used by earlier researchers
To explain why hematite is found only on Earth
questions.evidence: Past studies had suggested a mineral called hematite might be the cause.
questions.explanation_ko: 이는 새로운 발견을 소개하기 전에 이전의 설명을 배경 정보로 제공하기 위한 것입니다.

questions.stem: In the sentence "Valantinas noted the discovery of widespread ferrihydrite suggests Mars once held liquid water," the word "widespread" most nearly means:
options: Rare and isolated
Extensive and found in many places
Newly created
Difficult to detect
questions.evidence: Valantinas noted the discovery of widespread ferrihydrite suggests Mars once held liquid water that would have made it possible for the planet to support some form of life.
questions.explanation_ko: 'widespread'는 '널리 퍼진, 광범위한'이라는 뜻으로 여러 지역에 걸쳐 존재함을 의미합니다.

key_points: Scientists identified ferrihydrite, an iron oxide mineral, as likely responsible for Mars's red color.
Ferrihydrite forms in water-rich environments, suggesting Mars once had a large supply of liquid water.
The research was led by Brown University and the University of Bern and used data from multiple spacecraft and synthetic Martian dust.
The finding suggests Mars may once have had conditions capable of supporting some form of life.
Researchers say confirmation requires analyzing physical samples, which are being collected by NASA's Perseverance rover.
main_idea: New research using spacecraft data and synthetic materials suggests that the mineral ferrihydrite, which forms in water-rich environments, is likely responsible for giving Mars its red color and indicates the planet once had liquid water.
restate_sentence: Valantinas noted the discovery of widespread ferrihydrite suggests Mars once held liquid water that would have made it possible for the planet to support some form of life.
